profile: BioArctic AB (publ) is a Swedish research-based biopharma company focused on treatments for neurodegenerative diseases. It develops antibody-based drug candidates for Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease and ALS, and its BrainTransporter technology helps deliver medicines across the blood-brain barrier. Value is driven by royalties, partnerships, and license agreements, including Leqembi with Eisai.
